Base image apk works. The failure was after copying node binaries: `COPY --from=node /usr/local/lib /usr/local/lib` etc. Actually the `node:20-alpine3.23` image might have a different libc/musl or a newer apk-tools that overwrites `/usr/local/bin`? No, apk is in /sbin.

Wait — the error `apk_fs_is_malicious_filename: symbol not found` indicates the apk binary expects a newer libapk or a symbol that the installed musl/libapk doesn't have. This happens when apk-tools is upgraded but its library dependency isn't. Actually `apk_fs_is_malicious_filename` is a symbol in `libapk` (apk-tools shared library). In Alpine 3.23, apk-tools 3.0 introduced a shared library `libapk.so`. Copying node binaries wouldn't affect that.

Hmm, but copying `COPY --from=node /usr/lib /usr/lib` — node:20-alpine3.23 might include `/usr/lib/libapk.so`? No.

Actually, I bet the problem is `COPY --from=node /usr/local/lib /usr/local/lib` and the `apk` command is found in /usr/local/bin? No, `which apk` = /sbin/apk.
